title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: At DiscoWeb, we respect our users' privacy and prioritize protecting your data. This policy explains what data is collected while using our platform, how it is processed, and your rights.
intro_text: This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is collected, processed, and protected when you use the DiscoWeb platform (including the website and Discord bot). By using our platform, you are deemed to have accepted this policy.
intro_bullet_1: We do not sell your personal information to third parties
intro_bullet_2: We only collect data necessary for the service
intro_bullet_3: We do not store any passwords or sensitive credentials other than Discord OAuth2
intro_bullet_4: You can request deletion of your data at any time
about_text: DiscoWeb is a web-based management panel for Discord servers. The platform provides the following services:
about_item_1: Tracking server members' activity (message count, voice duration)
about_item_2: In-server virtual economy (Papel) with a store and role sales
about_item_3: Member-focused statistics and economy experience inside Discord Activity
about_item_4: Automated role management and notifications via Discord bot
what_text: The following data is collected or processed while using our platform:
what_cat1_desc: Obtained when you sign in with Discord OAuth2
what_cat1_item_3: List of servers you are a member of (servers where the bot is present)
what_cat2_item_1: Message count (message content is not stored)
what_cat2_item_3: Server join date and role information
what_cat3_item_1: Store purchase history and balance transactions
what_cat3_item_3: Audit logs – including IP address and browser information
what_important_text: We never store your Discord message content, direct messages, or voice recordings under any circumstances. Only message and voice activity counts/durations are processed.
use_text: Collected data is used only for the following purposes:
use_item_1: To verify user identity and manage sessions
use_item_2: To calculate server statistics and build leaderboards
use_item_4: To process store orders and assign purchased roles
use_item_5: To provide summaries and reports in the admin panel
use_item_6: To protect the security and integrity of the platform
sharing_text: Our platform uses the following third-party services to operate. Only the minimum data required for functionality is transferred to these services:
sharing_discord_purpose: User authentication, role management, server information
sharing_note: We never share or sell your personal data with third parties for advertising, marketing, or profiling purposes.
retention_text: Your data is retained under the following conditions:
retention_item_1: Account data – retained as long as your account is active
retention_item_2: Activity statistics – retained unless reset by the server administrator
retention_item_3: Order and transaction history – retained until account deletion
retention_item_4: Audit logs – may be retained for up to 90 days for security purposes
retention_delete_text: When you wish to delete your account, you can submit a request through the support channel on our Discord server. Deletion covers all your personal data and associated records.
protection_text: Technical measures we take to protect your data:
protection_item_1: All data transfers are protected with HTTPS/TLS encryption
protection_item_2: Database access is restricted with a service role key
protection_item_3: Discord OAuth2 tokens are stored in secure httpOnly cookies
protection_item_4: Only authorized users can access admin and developer panels
protection_item_5: Sensitive operations (balance changes, role assignments, etc.) are logged in the audit trail
control_text: As a user, you have the following rights:
control_right1_desc: You can request a copy of the data stored about you.
control_right2_desc: You can request correction of incorrect or incomplete information.
control_right3_desc: You can request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data.
control_right4_desc: You can object to the processing of your data at any time.
control_note: To exercise these rights, please contact us through the channels below. Requests are answered within 30 days at most.
contact_text: For questions about this privacy policy or your data:
contact_discord_value: You can reach us via the support channel
contact_update_notice: This policy may be updated from time to time. When significant changes are made, an announcement will be made via in-platform notification and/or our Discord server. You can follow the current policy on this page.
